description: Scientific PDF with embedded images and a dense table should keep table structure and surrounding captions.
notes: 2026-08-12: word spacing is now materialized from TJ displacements and Td horizontal moves in the native extractor (src/formats/pdf/extract_spacing_native.mbt, SPACE_RATIO 0.21), fixing the 'broken_spacing' loss for this producer. Measured after the fix: anchors 1.0, markdown_similarity 0.6956, ast_similarity 0.6, text_order 0.667, length 0.8; thresholds pin ~90% of the measured values and text_order is re-enabled. table_compare stays disabled: table_similarity is 0.0 because the dense table is not recovered without layout coordinates. Remaining glue such as 'H2SO4follow' comes from OpTm-positioned text, which the extractor does not track yet.
